name: Itoshii Ryuujin no Sodatekata
source:
Dragon family controls this country and governs over humans. Once in dozen years dragon king can peel off his scales and starts to look like a human. He wants to use this time to produce a child. A child born between dragon and human - how will he grow?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
龙族掌控着这个国家，统治着人类。十几年后，龙王就会剥去鳞片，开始变得像人类一样。他想利用这段时间生一个孩子。龙与人之间诞生的孩子——他将如何成长？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
